title: Section Charter and Governance
intro: Charter verification, Optica Local Section bylaw compliance, executive seat alignment, and annual reporting records.

bylawStandards.title: Minimum Member Standing
bylawStandards.requirement: At least 8 active section members, including at least 5 Optica Global members across academia, industry, or government.
bylawStandards.sectionStatus: Satisfied in the inaugural roster of 16 founding officers and faculty advisors.

bylawStandards.title: Elected Officers
bylawStandards.requirement: President, Vice President, Treasurer, and Secretary serving two-year calendar terms with active Optica membership.
bylawStandards.sectionStatus: All four constitutional executive seats filled in the inaugural charter roster.

bylawStandards.title: Decision Quorum
bylawStandards.requirement: 30% of section membership required for official business and elections.
bylawStandards.sectionStatus: Applied to section resolutions, committee governance, and election procedures.

bylawStandards.title: Annual Reporting
bylawStandards.requirement: Annual Activity Report and Membership Roster submitted to Optica by 31 December.
bylawStandards.sectionStatus: Tracked cleanly across dispatches, projects, and active member records.

annualReportScope.title: Events and Technical Meetings
annualReportScope.description: Confirmed seminars, workshops, and technical sessions published on the section calendar.

annualReportScope.title: Projects and Campus Outreach
annualReportScope.description: Active student initiatives, campus outreach activities, and hosting partnerships.

annualReportScope.title: Active Officer and Member Roster
annualReportScope.description: Constitutional officers, committee leads, advisors, and verified Optica membership IDs.

partnershipModels.title: University and Lab Hosting
partnershipModels.scope: Campus venues, computer labs, faculty advisorship, and Traveling Lecturer sessions.

partnershipModels.title: Industry Technical Exchange
partnershipModels.scope: Engineering talks, capstone mentorship, and prototyping/MPW sponsorship.

partnershipModels.title: National Science Alignment
partnershipModels.scope: Connecting student teams to ITIDA, ASRT, STDF, and regional STEM outreach.
